svg.text: Chordless D1 schema: the proposed final shape
licence (the CCLI licence it came in under)
private notes, songs added by me)
Every new id is a ULID (time-ordered); existing uuids stay.
No change feed and no tombstones: a space’s central data is
read whole; version only guards a write that was out of date.
Foreign keys inside a row (team_members.account_id and the
like) point at accounts and are not drawn.
Never in D1: ChordPro, MusicXML, lyrics, chords, pad audio,
share ciphertext. login_codes (hashed sign-in codes) is left out.
